name: The DigitalEro Game Episode 1
source:
Play as Dean DeMasso as he sneaks into the ultra-exclusive DE Clubhouse and has his fateful encounter with Sandra Daywalker! Make the right choices and you just might get laid; but be carefully, take the wrong step and you risk getting caught by the guards! Features 720 HD, 3D animated sex scenes, and seven different endings!

[From [url=http://renai.us/game/digitalero-game-ep-1]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
